title: My Grok Bots have been keeping things moving while I’m on the road.
description:
Theo’s been building out a kid-friendly UI for my 6 year old’s computer…
Scout’s been scouring the web for some properties…
And Simon has been reconciling my books.

I’m really loving this UI and how each Bot can work autonomously OR in a group chat all together. 

Use the link below if you want to try it out for yourself!

#grokbot #spacexaipartner @Grok
